studies.key_result: 12-month TBWL 16.6% +/- 8.6% (tirzepatide, n=207) vs 13.4% +/- 8.0% (semaglutide, n=304), P<.01. >=15% TBWL 56.8% vs 40.7%; >=20% 39.0% vs 22.1%. Without diabetes: 18.5% vs 14.2%.

studies.quality_rationale: Small retrospective chart review; abstract reports unadjusted comparisons, 92% White, likely selection and missing-weight bias.
